text:
Priya Patel: Heads-up: I'm landing a docs migration for the Console cost/latency page today. PR #501. Needs: a compact SDK code sample for fetching per-route latency percentiles (Node + Python), a short clarifying note about units (ms vs percentile), and verify the dashboard screenshot.
Alex Kim: I can do the Node sample. Keep it tiny and use the public SDK call. Also add a mention that p95 is computed server-side over the aggregation window.
Maya Singh: I'll do the Python sample and check the phrasing for the units note. Propose: 'Latency percentiles are reported in milliseconds (ms); server-side aggregation computes percentiles across the selected window.' Good?
Sam Liu: Found one stale anchor in the doc: `#old-latency-section` -> internal link. CI link-checker flagged it. I'll replace the anchor with `#latency-percentiles` and add a netlify redirect for the old anchor.
docs-bot: link-checker: broken anchor found in /docs/console/cost-latency -> `#old-latency-section`. CI preview: https://deploy-preview-501--docs.redwood.com/console/cost-latency
Priya Patel: Thanks. Maya, can you paste your Python snippet here?
Maya Singh: ```py
# Python (compact)
res = client.console.metrics.query({
  "window": "30m",
  "group_by": "route",
  "metrics": [{"name": "latency", "percentile": 95}]
})
```
Alex Kim: Node version: ```js
// Node (compact)
const res = await client.console.metrics.query({ window: '30m', group_by: 'route', metrics: [{ name: 'latency', percentile: 95 }] });
```
Priya Patel: Perfect. Maya, can you add the ms vs percentile note inline after the snippet?
Maya Singh: Added: "Note: latency percentiles are expressed in milliseconds (ms). Percentile values (e.g., p95) represent the latency below which that percentage of requests fall during the aggregation window."
Sam Liu: Redirect PR #502 created to add netlify redirect for `#old-latency-section` -> `/docs/console/cost-latency#latency-percentiles`. I'll CC eng-platform for telemetry label rename heads-up.
Priya Patel: Screenshot check: Sam, did you confirm the cost/latency dashboard is up-to-date?
Sam Liu: I grabbed a fresh export and uploaded to assets/screenshots/cost_latency_v3.png. Link in PR.
Alex Kim: Quick note: add a one-line tracing-hook snippet showing span attribute `redwood.route_name` so users can correlate logs/traces/metrics. One-liner OK.
Maya Singh: Adding the tracing snippet: ```js
span.setAttribute('redwood.route_name', routeName);
```
Priya Patel: CI preview looks good after the link fix. Merging after 1 final review from Alex.
Alex Kim: Approved and merged PR #501. Will follow up if eng-platform changes telemetry labels.
_notes: Docs thread for Console cost/latency migration: compact SDK snippets for latency percentiles, linkfix for anchor, screenshot upload, and a tracing hook one-liner.
